raw_segments.text: Another discreditable feature is that, for a like reason, they are incapable of carrying on any war.
Either they arm the multitude, and then they are more afraid of them than of the enemy.
Or, if they do not call them out in the hour of battle, they are oligarchs indeed, few to fight as they are few to rule.
And at the same time, their fondness for money makes them unwilling to pay taxes.
